status_recommendation_rationale: Published Frank–Mañibo Example 10 (2022; arXiv v1 2021) provides a singular physical scalar spin comb whose pointwise squared weights have Lebesgue diffraction and hence an AC observable on the actual original weighted hull. This is a recoverable earlier broad-target resolution, using the published numerical-error assertion. It does not match or clear priority of the frozen weight-one Meyer strengthening.

physical_weighted_hull_information_test: The scalar alphabet {1,i,-1,-i} records spins injectively and its pointwise square is a function on the original weighted-comb hull. No retained colour or digit hull is substituted for that physical hull.
